name: Kevlar vest
text: Toughness 1 against guns and blades. Doesn't stack with other Toughness.

name: Tactical armor
text: Toughness 1 against everything, but Disadvantage on Vanish and climbing.

name: Sidearm
text: A gun (Flow to shoot). Far range is at Disadvantage.

name: Long gun
text: A gun with no Far penalty. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Baton
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better. Works with Strikes and Jabs.

name: Fighting sticks
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better. Works with Strikes and Jabs.

name: Weighted gloves
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better. Works with Strikes and Jabs.

name: Bat
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only as a Full Action.

name: Pipe
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only as a Full Action.

name: Crowbar
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only as a Full Action.

name: Knife
text: +1 Harm against anyone without Toughness. Can be thrown at Near range.

name: Grapple line
text: Quick Action: move to any zone you can see, including High Ground.

name: Med kit
text: Once per fight, Full Action: an ally next to you clears one Harm box (Down becomes Wounded).

name: Night-vision goggles
text: Dark zones don't affect you.

name: Police scanner
text: Once per Night, Edge on a Patrol roll. You also hear the cops coming a round early.

name: Earpiece comms
text: You can Help allies in any zone.

name: Taser
text: Works like the Kit Taser: a Jab, and on a hit the target loses their next Quick Action. Electricity, so it ignores Toughness. Two uses per fight.

name: Pepper spray
text: Quick Action, Engaged. On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of their next turn.

name: Smoke grenades
text: Works like Kit Smoke: Quick Action, a zone becomes Dark until the end of next round. Two per fight.

name: Flashbangs
text: Works like the Kit Flashbang: Quick Action, roll Flow against the Guard of everyone in a zone; everyone you beat has Disadvantage on their next roll. One per fight.

name: Bolas or net launcher
text: Ranged, Near. On a hit, the target can't take their free move until they spend a Quick Action to get free.

name: Riot shield
text: +1 Guard. Take Cover works anywhere. Disadvantage on Vanish, and you can't use a long gun.

name: Mask and voice changer
text: Edge on rolls to scare or bluff someone who doesn't know you. Being unmasked costs 2 Stress instead of 1 Heat.

name: Lockpicks and bypass kit
text: Edge on getting through locked doors, alarms and safes. On Patrol, a lead through a locked place costs nothing extra.

name: Burner phones
text: Once per Night, contact an informant or ally without ticking Heat.

name: Bike or car
text: Out of fights: move between leads with no time cost once per Night. In a chase, Edge on Flow.

name: Drone
text: Quick Action: see into any zone within Far range. Allies attacking a target you've spotted get Edge, once per round. Breaks on any hit.

name: Climbing gear and gloves
text: Hard climbs to High Ground need no roll. No Hazard cost for falls of one story.

name: Bow (or crossbow)
text: Ranged, Flow to shoot, no Far penalty. +1 Harm on Impact 2+. Silent, so it causes no Heat. Not a gun: no graze rule, and Toughness applies.

name: Stun grenade
text: Quick Action, Near zone. Everyone there without ear and eye protection rolls Focus vs 12 or loses their next turn; mooks just lose it. Allies in the zone are caught too. One per fight.

name: Taser gun
text: Near range. On a hit, instead of Harm, the target loses their next Quick Action and a mook drops. Electricity, so it ignores Toughness. Two shots per fight, and reloading between them takes a Quick Action.

name: Martial arts training
text: Your bare hands count as light melee (+1 Harm on Impact 2 or better, works with Strikes and Jabs). It can't be taken away, lost or left at home.
